## 📝 Pull Request Checklist

Thank you for contributing! Please review and complete this checklist before submitting your PR.

### Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes made and the problem solved.

### Related Issue
Closes # (issue number)

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring (performance tuning, styling cleanups)
- [ ] Documentation update

### Quality Control Checklist:
- [ ] My code builds successfully with zero compilation warnings or errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] I have executed ESLint rules and resolved any warnings (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] I have executed unit tests and confirmed that all suites pass (`npm run test`)
- [ ] I have used granular selectors for Zustand store subscriptions to prevent redundant re-renders
- [ ] All new UI components utilize Sentence Case titles and have correct ARIA accessibility tags

### Verification & Screenshots
Please describe the manual verification tests you performed. Include screenshots or visual walkthroughs for UI/UX modifications.
